user.title: Configure Extended Web Search
user.description: Set up the extended web search integration. This requires a running SearXNG instance.

data_description.searxng_url: URL of your SearXNG server (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8080)
data_description.num_results: Number of search result pages to fetch content from
data_description.max_content_length: Maximum total characters of page content to return to the LLM
data_description.request_timeout: Timeout in seconds for each HTTP request
